contentText: The war ​in the Middle ​East will not give Russia respite in its own ​conflict ‌with ⁠Ukraine, French President Emmanuel Macron said ‌on Friday during a ⁠visit by Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy in ​Paris. Macron added that ‌it was strange to see Russia calling ‌for a ceasefire in the ​Middle East when it obstinately refuses to accept one with ​Ukraine. Macron said France's ​support for ​Ukraine would remain resolute and he ​was determined to continue military support for Ukraine.
